About.para1: Faced with the rapidly changing landscape of the AI era and ever-increasing demands from clients, Sun* chooses a strategy of diversifying capabilities — not only striving to excel in their field, but aiming for a higher destination where every Sunner becomes a 'problem-solver': an expert at resolving any issue, finding answers to every challenge of projects, clients, and society.
About.para2: Drawing inspiration from diverse capabilities, flexible growth, and the tireless creative spirit of the AI era, 'Root Further' was chosen as the official theme of the Sun* Annual Awards 2025 ceremony.
About.para3: Going beyond the surface, 'Root Further' is the journey of continuously reaching further, rooting more deeply, touching deeper 'geological layers' to keep existing, rising, and nurturing the ever-flowing passion for creating value that defines every Sunner. As a root system pushes deep into the earth — passing through each 'sediment layer' to absorb what is most essential — Sunners are also 'absorbing' nutrients from the era and market challenges to renew themselves daily, expand their capabilities, and firmly 'root' into the AI era: an entirely new, complex, and unpredictable 'geological layer', yet filled with boundless potential and opportunity.
About.quote: A tree with deep roots fears no storm — English Proverb
About.para4: Before the storm, only trees with strong enough roots can stand firm. An organization with confident individuals possessing diverse capabilities, ready to create and embrace challenges, and in control of change — such an organization not only stands resilient against turbulence but also exploits every advantage. More than just a name for an awards program, 'Root Further' is an encouragement for each of us to dare to believe in ourselves, dig deep, unlock all potential, dare to break limits, and become the most versatile and outstanding version of ourselves. Because in the AI era, diverse capabilities and leveraging the power of the times are the prerequisite for longevity.
About.para5: No one can predict who will lead in technology and the modern market with all its mysterious 'layers'. What we know is that when 'Root Further' has become the core spirit, we will not be fearful, but will keep moving forward on the journey ahead. For we always believe that in those boundless realms, countless wonders and opportunities are waiting for us.

KudosSection.description:
SAA 2025 HIGHLIGHTS
A recognition and appreciation activity — happening for the first time for all Sunners. The activity will launch in November 2025, encouraging Sunners to share recognition and thanks to colleagues on the official system. These will serve as reference material for the Heads Council in the selection process.

WriteKudo.heading: Send thanks and recognition to your teammate
WriteKudo.badgeHint1: Example: The one who motivates me.
WriteKudo.badgeHint2: The badge will appear as your Kudos title.
WriteKudo.contentHint: You can "@ + name" to mention other colleagues
WriteKudo.notLoggedIn: You need to log in to send Kudos
